sourceSelectionNotes: AmbientCG supplies the six selected PBR surfaces; its downloadable assets are CC0 1.0.
Kenney City Kit Roads supplies the selected street props; the inspected package is version 2.2 and includes its CC0 license file.
Poly Haven and Quaternius remain alternate catalogs for later additions; this first set stays small and avoids duplicate materials or a bulk model import.
